name: allow-weights-on-a-rest-day
why: Advise, then allow (his ruling 28 Nov 2026, docs/plans/advise-then-allow.md): 'if somebody wants to train on the day they weren't supposed to, they should be able to add it and log it in the app.' Wednesday is a rest day between Tuesday's legs and Thursday's upper body. A clear ask, so the coach offers the session (propose_train_today, whose card carries the app's own advice), never 'there's no session today'. Training a rest day is none of the four hard stops. Worded so none of it is the coach prompt's own example ('Add a weight session just for today'), which would make the case an answer key.
